# PURISTA LLM Context

PURISTA is a TypeScript framework for message-driven backend systems.

## Published context files
- Public root context: `/llms/llms.txt`
- Public deep context: `/llms/llms-full.txt`
- Public sandbox context: `/llms/sandbox-service.txt`
- Public sandbox deep context: `/llms/sandbox-service-full.txt`

## Canonical docs
- Handbook index: https://github.com/puristajs/purista/blob/master/website/doc/handbook/index.md
- Agent handbook: https://github.com/puristajs/purista/blob/master/website/doc/handbook/2_building_business-logic/agent/index.md
- Ecosystem docs: https://github.com/puristajs/purista/blob/master/website/doc/handbook/3_eco_system/index.md
